rot.ideia.ex1.e1: The queen is strong, but on her own she cannot give checkmate: she needs the king's help.
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: The black king is on the edge. The white king, in front of it, covers d7, e7 and f7.
rot.ideia.ex1.e3: What is missing is a check along the 8th rank. The queen covers the whole rank, d8 and f8 included.
rot.ideia.ex1.p: Give checkmate with the queen, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: That's right! Checkmate: the queen gives check and the king covers the front.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The queen goes up to a8 and checks along the 8th rank. The black king has nowhere to go.
rot.ideia.ex1.alt.a1h8.1: That is mate too! The queen reaches the 8th rank along the diagonal, from the other side.
rot.ideia.ex1.alt.a1h8.2: Look also at the mate with the queen on a8.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.a1f6.1: Careful! With the queen on f6, the black king is not in check.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.a1f6.2: And it has no move at all: it is stalemate, and the game is a draw.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.a1f6.3: Let's go back: the mate comes with a check along the edge rank.
rot.ideia.ex1.fora: That move is not mate. Let's go back: the check comes along the edge rank.
rot.ideia.ex1.volta: Give checkmate with the queen, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: The white king gives no check, but it covers the squares in front. Without it, the black king would escape.
rot.ideia.ex1.l2: Remember the idea: black king on the edge, white king in front of it, and the queen gives check.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: With the black king in the corner, there is a danger: stalemate.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: A stalemated king is not in check and has no move. The game ends in a draw.
rot.ideia.ex2.e3: The white king on f6 protects g7. If the queen goes there, the black king cannot capture her.
rot.ideia.ex2.p: Give checkmate without stalemating the king, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: That's right! Checkmate. The black king cannot capture the queen: the white king protects it.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The queen goes to g7 and gives check, protected by the king on f6. It is mate.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.g1g6.1: The queen on g6 takes away all the black king's squares, but gives no check.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.g1g6.2: The black king has no move and is not in check: stalemate, and it is a draw.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.g1g6.3: Let's go back: look for a check with the queen protected by the king.
rot.ideia.ex2.fora: That move is not mate. Let's go back: look for a check with the queen protected by the king.
rot.ideia.ex2.volta: Give checkmate without stalemating the king, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: Remember the idea: before each move, check whether the black king still has a square or is in check.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: Now I will show how to drive the black king to the edge.
rot.demos.caixa.e1: The queen pushes the king on her own. The secret is to stay a knight's jump away from it.
rot.demos.caixa.l1: The queen goes to c5, a knight's jump from the king. It loses the squares below.
rot.demos.caixa.l3: The queen follows the king, again a knight's jump away.
rot.demos.caixa.l4: The king runs to the other side.
rot.demos.caixa.l5: The king's box gets smaller with every move.
rot.demos.caixa.l6: A few moves later, the black king is stuck on the edge.
rot.demos.rei.e1: With the black king stuck, the queen stops pushing: she just waits.
rot.demos.rei.l1: Now it is the white king that walks, until it is close to the black king.
rot.demos.rei.l2: The white king has reached f6. Meanwhile, the black one could only move between h8 and h7.
rot.demos.rei.l3: Checkmate! The queen on g7 is protected by the king.
rot.demos.rei.l4: Now it's your turn: in the next positions, you give mate with the queen.
rot.pratica.borda.enunciado: Give checkmate. The black king is on the left edge: the check comes along the a-file.
rot.pratica.borda.fim: Perfect. The king covers the front, and the queen checks along the edge.
rot.pratica.rei.enunciado: Give checkmate. Put the white king right in front of the black king; then check on the edge.
rot.pratica.rei.fim: Well done. First the king, then the queen: that is the queen mate.
rot.pratica.rei.err.g5f6: On f6, the black king still has two squares. Stand right in front of it. Try again.
rot.pratica.maquina.enunciado: Now against the machine: box with the queen, king close, then mate. Beware of stalemate.
rot.pratica.maquina.fim: You gave the queen mate against the machine.
